eligibility_rules.sha_disjoint: SHA-256 absent from every tracked evaluation/research/docs artifact
eligibility_rules.program_disjoint: stem and OriginalFilename stem not previously evaluated or reserved
eligibility_rules.near_duplicate: import-set Jaccard < 0.85 vs previously evaluated programs on disk and earlier candidates

limitations: Benign-only cohort (signed Windows utilities); no malicious, packed, third-party, DLL or detector-error strata.
Program-level independence is judged by name/version/import similarity; functional relatedness (e.g. network diagnostics family) remains possible.
